'''Cutting the Clouds''' is a [[sword form]]. The movements associated with this form are unknown. [[Lan Mandragoran]] once used this form to cut off an assassin's hand in [[Canluum]].{{ref/book|0|16}} There may be a very tenuous allusion to "Wave Hands Like Clouds" from [[Wikipedia:Tai Chi|Tai Chi]].
